title: Silver disc above the mesa darts away
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of Silver disc above the mesa darts away, about 2016-10-14 at Mesa, Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: straight ahead of us above the mesa and there is literally a silver grayish disc-like object about a hundred feet above the mesa just sitting there suspended in the air
I went from being a skeptic to an experiencer within a matter of minutes.
tellings.difference: Frames it as his first sighting, the one that turned him from skeptic to experiencer, and credits Eric Bard.
tellings.link_reason: Fugal tells the same 2016 sighting, firsthand, of a silver-grey disc hovering above the mesa.

as_told.title: Fugal's first sighting: silver-grey disk above the mesa

tellings.quote: what can only be described as a physical craft. I mean, a flying saucer 100 ft above the mesa in broad daylight, right in front of us,
tellings.difference: Calls it a physical flying saucer in broad daylight and does not say it darted away.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe a disc seen in daylight in 2016, about 100 ft above the mesa at Skinwalker Ranch, by people who were there.

as_told.title: Flying saucer 100 ft above the mesa in daylight

plain: Brandon Fugal is the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange events. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels in 2022, he says that on 14 October 2016 he looked straight ahead above the mesa, a flat-topped hill on the ranch. He says a silver-gray disc was hanging in the air about a hundred feet above it, and then it darted away. In a 2026 episode of the same show, he calls it his first sighting, the one that turned him from a skeptic into an experiencer within minutes. There he credits Eric Bard, who was with him. He also describes it as a physical craft, a flying saucer in broad daylight right in front of them, without saying it darted off. If true, it would mean a solid craft showed itself openly over the ranch. All the tellings are Fugal's own, years apart, with a fellow witness named.
